credits.title: Dirty Blue
credits.overview: A struggling writer and ride-share driver tries to examine his life from within the confines of his car.

credits.title: The Hitcher
credits.overview: A grieving hitchhiker's self-imposed isolation is interrupted after going viral.

credits.title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
credits.overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

credits.title: Our Effed Up World
credits.overview: Grieving the recent loss of her grandmother, a young woman and her ragtag group of friends become the town's only defense when a mysterious alien entity crash-lands in the woods with an insatiable hunger.

credits.title: Jimpa
credits.overview: Hannah and her non-binary teenager Frances visit her gay grandfather Jimpa in Amsterdam. Frances expresses a desire to stay with their grandfather for a year, challenging Hannah's parenting beliefs and forcing her to confront past issues.

credits.title: The Preservers
credits.overview: Four weary rebels of an inhuman regime desperately gather to preserve the most outlawed contraband of all: joy, laughter and stories of those they lost who made them feel human.

credits.title: Guttercat
credits.overview: A punk sapphic couple attempt to wipe away their drug debt in Adelaide's seedy southern suburbs.

credits.title: The Bear Hunt
credits.overview: Determined to make her beloved teddy bear look 'normal' before her birthday, 12-year-old Ellie's search takes her on a journey that changes the way she understands difference; both in her bear and in herself.

credits.title: Great Deliverance
credits.overview: When an elderly gay man visits a young loner in 1950s Adelaide, they both must reconcile their opposing beliefs before a traumatic event seals their fate.

credits.title: Chokeberries
credits.overview: In the aftermath of a breakup, two young lovers seek solace in sharing their petty emotions with their closest friends.

credits.title: THIS IS FINE.
credits.overview: A global crisis. A lockdown. Three housemates. One ice cube.

credits.title: Bulldog
credits.overview: Charlie and Jack find an escape from the brutality of country footy in an isolated beach, and each other.
